[b][color=#00ff00][u][size=5]MOD DETAILS:[/size][/u]
[/color][/b]
Seven new shops are added to the game in the form of mythical creatures located in different zones of the game. As you increase friendship with the shop-keeps, they will sell you better items.  This is flavored as though you are leaving offerings to the nature spirits, and you are being rewarded for your services.[color=#ffff00]



[/color][b][u][size=4]NEW CROPS:[/size]

[/u]- 135 New crops[/b][list]
[*]Tea leaves can be processed into several different types of tea, in addition to black tea.  White tea becomes yellow, rooibos becomes red, black can be processed into an additional tea as well; all done via "realistic" means (If Basic Production addon is used).
[*]13 produce giant crops (Some Giant Crop artwork done by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/55537262]6480[/url]).
[*]Dozens of additional crop items dropped via [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6069]Multi Yield Crops[/url]﻿.
[/list][b]

[/b][b]- 140 New Trees[/b][list]
[*]Plums become prunes in dehydrator, pimento become allspice, grapes become raisins. These new items also act as "fruit" for production purposes.
[*]﻿Some of the trees and crops are "legendary" or "mythical" (ie: Yggdrasil which has a Bifrost Flower) which appear as top tier crops. 
[/list]


[b][u][size=4]NEW NPCs:[/size]

[/u][/b]- Seven new friendable NPCs as shop-keeps. Their item availability is linked to their friendship points.﻿It is advised that you read the mail they send. They send very detailed mail that explains how a few mod specific things work.
[list]
[*]Portrait Artwork for NPCs by [url=https://www.etsy.com/shop/AberjaxStudios/]AberjaxStudios[/url]﻿.
[*]Portrait artwork and sprite work for Astrid & Valkyrie portrait art done by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/74479268]FellowClown[/url].﻿
[/list]


[b][size=4][u]NEW MACHINES (Basic Production Version)[/u]: [/size]
[/b]
    [size=1]*Please note that [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5038]PFM Automate[/url] is required if you want the Automate mod to function with my machines. [/size][list]
[*]Auto Mill - Grinds items into dusts and flours.
[*]Distillation Tank - Distills liquors, brandies and other spirits.
[*]Fermentation Tank - Ferments beers, sparkling wines and sparkling ciders.
[/list][list]
[*]Oxidizer - Processes teas, dehydrates, dries.  
[*]Puree Jar - Makes fruit purees, nut butters and other smooth artisan goods.
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/articles/1144][/url][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/articles/1144][/url][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/articles/1144]Basic Production Article[/url]﻿﻿ details all inputs for new machines, as well as new shop inventories.
[/list] ﻿ ﻿- Approximately 450 Artisan Goods.

[list]
[*]Desert Trader has new Spice and Herb mix recipes for trade.
[/list]


[b][size=4][u]NEW WEAPONS (Divine Weapon Addon)[/u]:[/size]
[/b]
[list]
[*]60+ Divine weapons which can be bought at the volcano caldera as each vendor reaches 10 hearts.
[/list]

Downloads.Description:
Adds coding for Produce to Sapling.



Does not include:


- Wood Trees (Because wood is sold by Robin from day 1. - eg: Ebony, Sandalwood)


- Legendary Trees (eg: Foxberry, Rose of Avalon, Winter Starberry)


- Divine Trees (eg: Dryad, Fusang, Yggdrasil)

Mods.RelativePath: Raffadax Produce to Sapling-13518--3-1-1661622163\RX Produce to Sapling - 3.1

Manifest.Name: Raffadax Produce to Sapling
Manifest.Description: Adds Produce to Sapling compatability code for Raffadax tree crops. Wood, Enchanted and Divine trees do not produce seeds via seedmaker.
Manifest.Author: Raffadax
